subtitle.en: Source: wamimi/noir-ckb-verifier @ bf09ccf / contracts/crates/owned-counter/src/main.rs　·　testnet 0x79d7…0a88 (data1)　·　research software, testnet only, single-party setup

label.zh: inputs[0]：任意（通常是 owner 的资金 cell）
label.en: inputs[0]: any (usually the owner's funding cell)

cons.zh: 创建时 = blake2b(inputs[0] ‖ 输出序号)；更新时不变
cons.en: on create = blake2b(inputs[0] ‖ output index); unchanged on update

cons.zh: 创建时必须 = 0（53）；更新时 new = old + 1 由证明保证
cons.en: must be 0 on create (53); new = old + 1 is enforced by the proof

cond.zh: args 长度 = 33、args[0] = 0x01、hash_type = data1
inputs / outputs / cell_deps 任一数量 ≥ 64
cond.en: any of inputs / outputs / cell_deps count ≥ 64

cond.zh: 全交易中同 code_hash+hash_type 的输入 ≤ 1、输出 = 1，且 group 输出 = 1、group 输入 = 该输入数（不可销毁、不可分裂、不可合并）
cond.en: across the whole tx: inputs with the same code_hash+hash_type ≤ 1, outputs = 1; group outputs = 1, group inputs = that input count (no burn, split or merge)

cond.zh: ckb-std validate_type_id(args[1..])
恰好 9 字节且 data[0] = 0x01
code_hash = secp256k1_blake160 (0x9bd7…cce8)、hash_type = type、args 20B；cell_deps（展开后）中恰好 1 个 type hash = 0x9bd7…cce8 的 cell，且其 data hash = 0x709f…8649
cond.en: code_hash = secp256k1_blake160 (0x9bd7…cce8), hash_type = type, args 20B; exactly one cell_dep (after expansion) with type hash 0x9bd7…cce8 and its data hash = 0x709f…8649

cond.zh: 任何 syscall 加载失败
data[1..9] 必须全 0
交易第一个输入（不是 group 输入）的 lock hash = 输出 counter 的 lock hash
cond.en: lock hash of the tx's first input (not a group input) = output counter lock hash

note.zh: 创建时不需要证明，也不检查 witness；capacity 不受限制
note.en: No proof and no witness on create; capacity unrestricted

extras: cell_deps: [ secp256k1 dep_group, OWNED_COUNTER code, {{VK cell (data hash 0x685b…58fe)}} ]

cons.zh: 创建时必须 = 0（53）；更新时 new = old + 1 由证明保证
cons.en: must be 0 on create (53); new = old + 1 is enforced by the proof

role.zh: molecule table 头：total_size + 2 个 offset
FrVec：count u32 LE(=4) ‖ old ‖ new ‖ ctx_lo ‖ ctx_hi（各 32B LE）
role.en: FrVec: count u32 LE(=4) ‖ old ‖ new ‖ ctx_lo ‖ ctx_hi (32B LE each)

cons.zh: 必须逐字节等于合约重建的 expected
cons.en: must equal the contract-rebuilt expected byte for byte

note.zh: 整个 WitnessArgs ≤ 512B（读入固定缓冲区，超出即 48）；lock 字段可同时携带 owner 的 secp256k1 签名。wire 格式字段名取自 crates/artifact-adapter/src/wire.rs，具体解码在外部 crate groth16-ckb@d64c769 wire-decode（未逐行阅读）
note.en: Whole WitnessArgs ≤ 512B (fixed buffer, else 48); the lock field may carry the owner's secp256k1 signature. Field names from crates/artifact-adapter/src/wire.rs; decoding lives in the external crate groth16-ckb@d64c769 wire-decode (not read line by line)

label.en: expected public inputs (132B, rebuilt by the contract)

note.zh: digest = blake2b_ckb("noir-ckb/owned-counter/context/v1\0" ‖ NETWORK_DOMAIN(测试网 genesis 哈希) ‖ blake2b_ckb("noir-ckb/owned-counter/v1") ‖ 本 type script hash ‖ args[1..33] ‖ 0x01 ‖ 被消耗 cell 的 OutPoint(36B) ‖ old data 9B ‖ new data 9B ‖ 输出 lock hash ‖ 输出 capacity u64 LE)
note.en: digest = blake2b_ckb("noir-ckb/owned-counter/context/v1\0" ‖ NETWORK_DOMAIN (testnet genesis hash) ‖ blake2b_ckb("noir-ckb/owned-counter/v1") ‖ this type script hash ‖ args[1..33] ‖ 0x01 ‖ consumed cell OutPoint (36B) ‖ old data 9B ‖ new data 9B ‖ output lock hash ‖ output capacity u64 LE)

cond.zh: args 长度 = 33、args[0] = 0x01、hash_type = data1
inputs / outputs / cell_deps 任一数量 ≥ 64
cond.en: any of inputs / outputs / cell_deps count ≥ 64

cond.zh: 全交易中同 code_hash+hash_type 的输入 ≤ 1、输出 = 1，且 group 输出 = 1、group 输入 = 该输入数（不可销毁、不可分裂、不可合并）
cond.en: across the whole tx: inputs with the same code_hash+hash_type ≤ 1, outputs = 1; group outputs = 1, group inputs = that input count (no burn, split or merge)

cond.zh: ckb-std validate_type_id(args[1..])
恰好 9 字节且 data[0] = 0x01
code_hash = secp256k1_blake160 (0x9bd7…cce8)、hash_type = type、args 20B；cell_deps（展开后）中恰好 1 个 type hash = 0x9bd7…cce8 的 cell，且其 data hash = 0x709f…8649
cond.en: code_hash = secp256k1_blake160 (0x9bd7…cce8), hash_type = type, args 20B; exactly one cell_dep (after expansion) with type hash 0x9bd7…cce8 and its data hash = 0x709f…8649

cond.zh: 任何 syscall 加载失败
旧 cell data 恰好 9 字节且 data[0] = 0x01
cond.en: old cell data exactly 9 bytes and data[0] = 0x01

cond.zh: 输入与输出的 lock hash 相同（不可转让）
cond.en: input and output lock hash equal (non-transferable)

cond.zh: 输出 capacity = 输入 capacity
witness 缺失 / 超 512B / 非 WitnessArgs / 无 input_type / wire 解码失败
cond.en: witness missing / > 512B / not WitnessArgs / no input_type / wire decode fails

cond.zh: 证明中的 public inputs ≠ 重建的 expected（132B）
data hash = VK_DATA_HASH 的 cell_dep 必须恰好 1 个，读入 ≤ 512B 且可解码
cond.en: exactly one cell_dep with data hash = VK_DATA_HASH, ≤ 512B and decodable

cond.zh: Groth16(BN254) 验证失败

note.zh: new = old + 1 不在合约代码里比较，而是由 Noir 电路（circuits/owned-counter-v1）断言，经证明强制（非本合约直接检查）
note.en: new = old + 1 is not compared in the script code; the Noir circuit (circuits/owned-counter-v1) asserts it and the proof enforces it (not a direct script check)

notes.zh: 错误码（main.rs）：40 LOAD · 41 ARGS · 42 SHAPE · 43 STATE · 44 ID · 45 OWNER · 46 OWNER_CHANGED · 47 CAPACITY · 48 WITNESS · 49 PUBLIC · 50 VK · 51 PROOF · 52 LIMIT · 53 INIT
notes.en: Error codes (main.rs): 40 LOAD · 41 ARGS · 42 SHAPE · 43 STATE · 44 ID · 45 OWNER · 46 OWNER_CHANGED · 47 CAPACITY · 48 WITNESS · 49 PUBLIC · 50 VK · 51 PROOF · 52 LIMIT · 53 INIT

notes.zh: NETWORK_DOMAIN / OWNER_CODE_HASH / OWNER_DATA_HASH / VK_DATA_HASH 是编译期常量（build.rs 从环境变量写入）；测试网部署值见 releases/owned-counter-v1-testnet/manifest.json
notes.en: NETWORK_DOMAIN / OWNER_CODE_HASH / OWNER_DATA_HASH / VK_DATA_HASH are build-time constants (build.rs reads env vars); testnet values in releases/owned-counter-v1-testnet/manifest.json

notes.zh: 没有销毁路径：任何交易都必须恰好输出 1 个 counter cell（42）
notes.en: No burn path: every tx must output exactly one counter cell (42)
